pages.text: A $(l)Resin$() is a one-shot additive that makes a blueprint print come out $(l)finer$() — better, not just bigger. Drop one into the $(l)Resin slot$() (between the upgrade and spool columns) before you print.$(br2)Two rules: a resin is $(l)used up$() each print, and it only works on $(l)found blueprints$() — the curated discs you loot or take from creative, never ones you scanned yourself.

pages.title: Tiers
pages.text: Resins come in three tiers. $(l)Tier 1-2$() are craftable; $(l)Tier 3$() is found only, in end-game loot. Higher tiers are stronger — and a few effects exist only at the top.
Everything starts with $(item)Resin Base$() — $(item)Extrudium Crystal$() plus any slimeball. Add a tier ingredient (a gem for Tier 2) and an effect ingredient to finish a resin.
